title: The keyboard cannot get around permission or status limits
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role, which has Work orders > View and Create & Edit) at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • A second user {User-B} has the custom role {Role-A}, which allows Work orders: View only, and is signed in in a second browser.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST C97020 Viewer and {Role-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C97020 View Only.
  • Technician {Technician-A} is active at {Location-A} with the "Technician" role and is pinned in Board View for both users.
    For example: {Technician-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C97020 Ana.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has two work orders led by {Technician-A}: {Work-order-1}, Approved, and {Work-order-2}, Invoiced. None has a shift on the Schedule.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C97020 Limits, and {Work-order-1} and {Work-order-2} are S10043-17711 and S10043-17712.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, the name of {Customer-A} in "Search", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide, for both users.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the second browser (signed in as {User-B}), click once in the "Search" box.
  2. Press Tab until a card shows a focus ring.
  3. Use the arrow keys to move the focus ring to the card for {Work-order-1}.
  4. Press Tab.
  5. Press Enter.
  6. Press Space, then Shift with each arrow key.
  7. In your own browser ("Admin" role), click once in the "Search" box.
  8. Press Tab until a card shows a focus ring.
  9. Use the arrow keys to move the focus ring to the card for {Work-order-2}.
  10. Press Tab.
  11. Press Enter.
  12. Choose "Reassign lead technician" with the arrow keys and press Enter.
  13. Press Escape.
  14. Press Space, then Shift with each arrow key.
  15. Refresh the page.
  16. Click the card for {Work-order-2}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the cursor is in the "Search" box.
  • Step 2: a card shows the focus ring.
  • Step 3: the card for {Work-order-1} shows the focus ring.
  • Step 4: if the card has a "More actions" (…) button, it now has the focus; otherwise focus leaves the board.
  • Step 5: "Reassign lead technician" cannot be reached: no menu opens, or it is not offered, or it is disabled and nothing happens.
  • Step 6: no key moves {Work-order-1}; it keeps its place and its lead, {Technician-A}.
  • Step 7: the cursor is in the "Search" box.
  • Step 8: a card shows the focus ring.
  • Step 9: the card for {Work-order-2} shows the focus ring.
  • Step 10: the card's "More actions" (…) button shows and has the focus.
  • Step 11: the menu opens and "Reassign lead technician" is disabled, with the note "The lead technician can’t be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid."
  • Step 12: nothing happens; no dialog opens.
  • Step 13: the menu closes.
  • Step 14: no key moves {Work-order-2} to another technician.
  • Step 15: Board View shows {Work-order-2} in {Technician-A}'s column.
  • Step 16: the work order page opens and "Lead Technician" reads {Technician-A}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; stories SV-10054 (Story 11, Keyboard access and focus), SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 61 (16 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S11-N1, S11-R9, S4-N1, S4-N6, S11-R1 and S11-R3, read 16 Oct 2026. Tech plan (revised 24 Sep 2026) Phase 11. Product owner answers: Chris Ward, WO Board and Tech View question sheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1gBGmNB4B1bRrD2ZJvBn1tuvbfxFPjcsKddz_I5H3CvU), answer 28, read 15 Oct 2026. Source-verified 16 October 2026. Last checked against build v26.40.19-1493c63 (staging) on 10/16/2026.

Until 15 Oct 2026 Story 11 only listed keyboard behaviour the design still had to define, so this case asked the tester to try keys and write down what each did. Chris Ward answered on 15 Oct 2026 (answer 28): Tab reaches every control, Enter opens, Escape closes, focus returns to the control that opened a menu or dialog, reassigning by keyboard goes through the ⋯ menu, and there is no keyboard drag. PRD version 54 rewrites Story 11 into these requirements, and this case now checks them.

Chris Ward's answer 28 (15 Oct 2026) and PRD version 54 said Tab reaches every row, card and header in on-screen order. PRD versions 55, 60 and 61 (15 and 16 Oct 2026, Chris Ward rulings on Slavcho Mitrov's questions and the QA triage of SV-11395, SV-11397, SV-11422 and SV-11421) changed this: each view is one Tab stop that lands on a work order, and the arrow keys move between cards, rows, headers and columns. This case follows version 61, the latest.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-N1: “Keyboard access must not bypass action permissions or work order status restrictions.”
  • S11-R9: “Reassigning by keyboard goes through the more-actions menu: Reassign lead technician opens the Reassign dialog, and Unassign is a menu item. There is no keyboard drag in this release, so reordering work orders and technicians is by mouse or touch only.”
  • S4-N1: “Require Work Orders create and edit permission to drag work orders or access Reassign lead technician.”
  • S4-N6: “The disabled Reassign lead technician action on an Invoiced or Paid work order shows this tooltip: “The lead technician can’t be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid.””
  • S11-R1: “Each view is a single Tab stop. Tab lands on one work order row (Tech View) or card (Board View), the one last focused, or the first one when none has been (never a group or column header while a work order is shown; when every group is collapsed, Tab lands on the first group header; after the user arrows onto a header and tabs out and back in, Tab returns to a work order row while any row is shown; on Board View, if the last-focused card has scrolled out of view in its column, Tab lands on the first card in view); the focused row or card shows a visible focus ring.”
  • S11-R3: “Inside a view the arrow keys move focus: Up and Down move between rows and group headers in Tech View, and between cards and the column header within a Board View column; Left and Right move between Board View columns. Tab from a focused row, card or header reaches its own controls (more actions, pin, collapse) in order, then leaves the view. Tab never stops on every row.”
  • Tech plan Phase 11 tests: “a keyboard-initiated reassign is refused for a locked status and without permission (S11-N1).”

AUTOMATION: READY
